$comment: Operations in the AlertRoster OpenAPI document that this node deliberately does not implement. Each needs a reason; scripts/check-openapi-coverage.mjs fails when an entry here is implemented or leaves the spec, so this list is also the tracked backlog of server surface the node lacks.

notImplemented.POST /api/v1/auth/refresh: Refresh tokens are unused on purpose: the server revokes the token family on reuse and concurrent executions share one cached session (utils/ResponderSession.ts).
notImplemented.DELETE /api/v1/auth/logout: The responder session is cached across executions and expires on its own; revoking it from one workflow would log out every other.
notImplemented.POST /api/v1/auth/request_link: Magic-link login is for a person at a browser, not a credential a workflow holds.
notImplemented.POST /api/v1/devices: Push registration is for phones and desktops; out of scope for v0.1 (design spec).
notImplemented.DELETE /api/v1/devices/{device_identifie: Push registration is for phones and desktops; out of scope for v0.1 (design spec).
notImplemented.GET /api/v1/receivers: Receivers (hardware pagers) are out of scope for v0.1 (design spec).
notImplemented.POST /api/v1/receivers: Receivers (hardware pagers) are out of scope for v0.1 (design spec).
notImplemented.GET /api/v1/receivers/catalogue: Receivers (hardware pagers) are out of scope for v0.1 (design spec).
notImplemented.POST /api/v1/receivers/enroll: Spends a claim for a client certificate; a device-side step, not a workflow one.
notImplemented.DELETE /api/v1/receivers/{id}: Receivers (hardware pagers) are out of scope for v0.1 (design spec).
notImplemented.DELETE /api/v1/users/me: Account deletion is irreversible and out of scope for v0.1 (design spec).
notImplemented.GET /api/v1/checkins/commands: The device half of search support: a phone polls for locate/beacon commands. Not a workflow surface.
notImplemented.POST /api/v1/checkins/commands/{id}/ack: The device half of search support: a phone reports what it did with a command. Not a workflow surface.
notImplemented.POST /api/v1/checkins/profile/photo: Photographs are a presigned-upload flow (mint, PUT the bytes, confirm); needs a binary-data design before the node grows it.
notImplemented.POST /api/v1/checkins/profile/photo/{id}: Photographs are a presigned-upload flow; see POST /api/v1/checkins/profile/photo.
notImplemented.DELETE /api/v1/checkins/profile/photo/{i: Photographs are a presigned-upload flow; see POST /api/v1/checkins/profile/photo.
notImplemented.PUT /api/v1/checkins/duress_code: Changes the duress code alone, proved by the current check-in code sent as `code` and not written. The node's Set Code already sends both codes through PUT /api/v1/checkins/code and models no separate proof parameter yet; landed on the server after node 0.2.0, not yet assessed.
notImplemented.POST /api/v1/checkins/{id}/positions: The device half of search support: a phone streams its own fixes during an armed window. Not a workflow surface.
notImplemented.GET /api/v1/checkins/fallback: App configuration for text or phone check-in when data is gone. A client-side concern, not a workflow one.
notImplemented.GET /api/v1/sources: Shipped by alertroster #376 on 2026-09-17; Source reads and the Source ID dropdown are n8n-nodes-alertroster #15.
notImplemented.GET /api/v1/escalation_policies: Shipped by alertroster #376 on 2026-09-17; Escalation Policy reads are n8n-nodes-alertroster #15.
notImplemented.GET /api/v1/escalation_policies/{id}: Shipped by alertroster #376 on 2026-09-17; Escalation Policy reads are n8n-nodes-alertroster #15.
